content.short: Galaxia Chronicles is a next-gen space-themed Web3 trading card game with NFT cards and a vibrant marketplace.
content.description: Galaxia Chronicles is a space-themed trading card game where players voyage through the cosmos, collect NFT cards, and trade with fellow explorers. The card lineup features seven rarities, ranging from Common to ultra-rare Chronicle editions, adding meaningful choices and strategic depth to the collection and interactions. Players open NFT packs, earn CRT tokens to redeem rare items, and trade cards in a vibrant marketplace that encourages ongoing collection growth. By design, players own their collection, both inside the game and on compatible external platforms, ensuring true asset ownership across contexts.
